tests.note: Green baseline. Any F5 regression is measured against 504/504.

db.policy: ADDITIVE (new optional field on existing store) → no DB_VERSION bump, bump record schemaRev + backfill. DESTRUCTIVE (drop/rename/reindex) → bump DB_VERSION + upgrade block.
db.f5_impact: ZERO schema change required. getAllGames is a NEW READ over the EXISTING 'games' store via the EXISTING 'playedAt' index. No new store, no new index, no new field → NO DB_VERSION bump (doctrine satisfied; explicitly justified).

i18n.catalogue: src/i18n/messages/* merged in src/i18n/messages/index.ts (8 domains: common, play, tactics, coach, analysis, journey, settings, generators)
i18n.parity_test: src/i18n/translate.test.ts — 'every message has non-empty fr AND en' (structural; Message = Record<Locale,string>) + 'no key collides across domains'
i18n.doctrine: Every NEW user-facing string in F5 needs fr+en in the SAME Message object → parity test passes by construction. Place new keys under the 'play' domain (Home+Play already there) or a new sub-namespace (e.g. history.*) without creating a new domain file unless warranted.
i18n.f5_new_strings_expected: history section labels (title, empty state, 'analysed'/'not analysed', open/analyse), PGN export label, PGN import-from-history labels — all bilingual.

insights_byte_identity.note: F5 adds a READ + a new history UI + PGN I/O. It does NOT touch studyPlan/insights selection logic. Insights output must stay byte-identical (AP-COACH-1 family). No F5 change to analysis/studyPlan.ts or weakness selection.

purity.rule: No Date/Math.random in logic modules; cores take now/locale as params.
purity.f5_impact: getAllGames is pure-ish (DB read, no clock). PGN-export filename may want a timestamp — derive from GameRecord.playedAt (already stored), NOT Date.now(), to keep any helper testable.
